title: Mackerel miso rice bowl
summary: Mackerel miso rice bowl is a japanese dinner built around mackerel fillets and rice miso paste, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat mackerel fillets dry and season it. Prep rice miso paste and basmati rice for Mackerel miso rice bowl so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook mackerel fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook rice miso paste and basmati rice in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Mackerel miso rice bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice mackerel fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
